note: This Data Specification describes business/functional data required by the approved requirements. It is NOT a database schema. No tables, engines, indexes, ORM models, or infrastructure are specified.

data_entities.purpose: A customer actor within the simulation who completes onboarding, provides KYC, activates an account, logs in/out, transfers and receives simulated money, and views/downloads statements.
data_entities.data_notes: Represented using synthetic identity data (BR-021). Exact data fields and validation constraints remain OPEN (OQ-013).

data_entities.purpose: KYC information provided by the customer, including Aadhaar and PAN information that is format-only and mocked.
data_entities.data_notes: Aadhaar/PAN verification is format-only and mocked; no real identity verification is performed (BR-002). Exact data fields and validation constraints remain OPEN (OQ-013).

data_entities.purpose: A customer account that can be activated or frozen by the customer or bank operations, and whose state is viewable.
data_entities.data_notes: Account state changes are auditable (BR-006). Exact account-state rules remain OPEN (OQ-006).

data_entities.purpose: Synthetic simulated balance associated with accounts within the simulation.
data_entities.data_notes: Balances are simulated using synthetic data (BR-001, BR-021). Minimum balance value remains OPEN (OQ-002).

data_entities.purpose: Synthetic beneficiary data used within the simulation for money movement.
data_entities.data_notes: Beneficiaries are synthetic (BR-021). Beneficiary management is out of scope per the approved BRD scope of work.

data_entities.purpose: Synthetic simulated payment representing transfer/receipt of simulated money.
data_entities.data_notes: Payments are simulated using synthetic data (BR-001, BR-021). Transfer/payment rules and limits remain OPEN (OQ-007, OQ-003).

data_entities.purpose: Statement data viewable and downloadable by the customer.
data_entities.data_notes: Statement content and download behaviour details remain OPEN (OQ-008).

data_entities.purpose: Record of auditable state changes accessible to bank operations.
data_entities.data_notes: State changes are auditable (BR-006). Exact audit events to be recorded remain OPEN (OQ-011).

data_entities.purpose: Roles (Customer and Bank Operations) used to keep journeys distinct via role-based access.
data_entities.data_notes: Two distinct roles exist (BR-005 business rule). Exact role permissions and authorization rules remain OPEN (OQ-009).
